items.text: Hello, fellow heroes!

Recently, we've come across quite a few "soul-searching questions" from players in our community. Some have called us a "reskinned game," while others have joked that Ge Jin taking off her shoes is a "borderline move."
We've carefully read through every piece of feedback, weighing it heavily and reflecting deeply. After much consideration, we felt it was only right to have an open conversation with all of you.
First, regarding the "reskin" issue: In the few months since the official launch of Realm of Ink, we've rolled out six skin appearances corresponding to the summer and autumn seasons.
Completing the skin sets for each form has always been our solemn promise to you. We're honored to say that, following the autumn update, we've finally fulfilled that promise.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/629052b6a7210a5f6c6e1fa8f197b2195f22d0e2.png"]
In fact, beyond the appearances everyone has been focusing on, we've also been dedicated to developing brand-new content.
However, compared to creating skins, core gameplay requires more time to polish.
Today, it's time to officially talk with you about our winter update plans.
First up is a brand-new playable form—the Dream Master Form.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/03bb8a44d97b46765eb06acba59799594598dfd0.png"]Illusionary Tricks Deceive the Heavens: Half a face hides mysteries, two hands perform the Four Symbols.
She comes with a completely new set of skill effects corresponding to four different attributes, which we believe will bring you a totally different visual experience.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/36985e0c97aeadb9aafa6f19b53088610333c50f.png"]
Additionally, along with the form update, we'll be adding a series of brand-new Curios.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/1aad689ab8f2b8e6e0a29e1fc54d9b4a4f8b5068.png"]
Why not take a guess at what unique effects they might hold, based on their appearances?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/34b13adf79484f5607dfc9961de470f1ff76f681.jpg"]
We've always been paying close attention to every discussion and request from you heroes in our community.
Therefore, in response to the feedback regarding the "Ge Jin shoes" issue, we've quickly adjusted the shoe-removal mechanic.

We've also noticed many other content pieces that players are looking forward to. In fact, some of them are already in intensive development, and we'll find the most suitable time to officially announce them to everyone.
Completing the skin sets is just the fulfillment of our phase-based promise; the future of Realm of Ink holds much more than this.
Besides the new winter form shared today, more surprises are on their way.
We sincerely thank all you heroes for your continued support and love.

If you encounter any issues or suspicious bugs during gameplay, please feel free to provide feedback and discuss them in our community. Our team will pay attention and handle them as soon as possible.
Wishing you all a pleasant gaming experience!
Best regards,
Leap Studio

items.text: Looking back, your "amazing moves" and "ingenious ideas" in the game have left us completely astonished! In the new year, may you casually get top-level treasures in the game world, and make the monsters flee at the sight of you, becoming the "big shots" in the gaming world! In real life, may you have no worries about getting promotions and salary increases, enjoy delicious food and beautiful scenery, and be carefree every day!

Although the update of MoJing has not arrived as scheduled, the members of the production team have never stopped developing new content. Now, let me report the development progress to our dear players.
New Year skin for A Kuan's form (I really didn't force them to make it, seriously! Believe me!)

I don't know if it's just my illusion! Ever since I got this new outfit, my gameplay feel has been amazing! I cleared the levels without taking any damage throughout the whole process! It's insanely awesome!
Next up is the new difficulty level that you players have been eagerly waiting for!
We haven't come up with a name for it yet, so for now, let's just call it - Longhao!
In the Longhao difficulty level, a scarlet aura begins to constantly emerge in the scroll world, indicating that the upcoming battles will become increasingly dangerous!!
In this Longhao difficulty, the monsters will be much more powerful. Moreover, the chapter boss battles at the end of each level have all learned new moves!

Our General White Ape can summon increasingly powerful monsters. At the same time, it has learned a new consecutive slashing move (maybe the White Ape form will have more surprises in the future). Everyone, please be careful!

The Nightmare Golden Monk in the second level has become even more powerful!! Not only has it mastered the Consecutive Shockwaves, but it can also charge up and unleash a Laser Cannon!!! Fellow warriors, be sure not to get hit. It really hurts~!!
The gentle (crazy) Miss Gejin in the third level will now make it even more difficult for you players to move forward. The difficulty of achieving a no-damage run has increased significantly!!!

Of course, the Longhao difficulty level has more in store. I, A Kuan, am keeping a little secret. I'm looking forward to your performance when MoJing is reborn. (This time, it's really not going to be that easy for you to clear the levels so easily!!!)
Remember the new mini - boss revealed in the last issue? This time, we've made a preliminary implementation of it (and it's still being continuously optimized).
The Shamaness Priestess (tentative name) in the Six - Eared Snow Cave.
She is proficient in setting up barriers, using formations to trap players and cast various spells.
Once trapped by her, players need to be extra careful.

Regarding the bosses, in the following time, we will add a random mini - boss to each chapter. For the final bosses, we'll also incorporate more new mechanisms and moves. (Haha, don't say that the new difficulty only has increased numbers. I, A Kuan, have personally tested it, and it's really tough!)

As for the progress of the fifth major level, the production team is nearly at the end. We're making great efforts to create our final boss battle. Here, we're releasing some recent design drawings for you players to have a first look.
It's really something to look forward to!!!
And finally, the much - anticipated CG image of Miss Qingyan.

items.text: It's been some times since our last update, and we promise that we've been working hard towards what we have promised in the roadmap to v1.0. And now, please welcome and enjoy the Major November Update!

notes.title: This update contains the following new features

items.text: New Ink Gem system: the Primordial Ink Gem. Offer the "Primordial Ink" Perk by sacrificing 2 Rare+ Ink Gems to receive the "Primordial Ink Gem". Each character form has a unique "Primordial Ink Gem" with exclusive effects and active skills.

New Special Perks: Boss Perks & Fragmented Perks.: Boss Perks: Each featuring exclusive effects tied to the specific boss.: Fragmented Perks: Collect fragments from the Foe Forge; combine four fragments to craft the "Deity Relic".: Additionally, this update introduces new mighty Perks: 2 Legendary, 3 Epic and 3 Rare.

Jade Ink Store: Now , you can spend the excessive amount of Jade Ink you've collected during the runs in the Jade Ink Store. Spend a certain amount of Jade Ink at the Peach God's statue on the inn's first floor to unlock advanced features, and more reward refreshes.
New Difficulty Lv.6: Difficulty Lv.6: Wyrm Hair Brush Unlocked. Features increased enemies' stats, adjusted enemy layouts in the room, and enhanced mini-bosses attack mechanics.

Multi-languages: Languages including Germany, Spanish, French, Brazilian-Portuguese, Russian, Japanese will be updated into the game on November 28th's patch update. If you find any bug/translation error/UI overload, or suggestions towards the translation, please join our Discord and go to #bug-report-and-suggestion channel, create a new thread and add the tag "Translation" to report your inquiry. Or you can join the dedicated language channel to discuss with others.: We truly appreciate all the feedback we have received from our players so far. Your insights and suggestions have been invaluable in helping us shape and improve Realm of Ink. We will continue to strive hard as we march towards the official v1.0 release. We look forward to having you with us on this exciting journey and experiencing more wonderful updates in the future!: Hope you have fun in the Realm of Ink!
Newly Added

1. Added "Wyrm Brush" difficulty: unlocked after clearing "Bear Hair Brush" difficulty, enemy number and distribution will be different under "Wyrm Brush" difficulty, Mid-Chapter Bosses will have new moves.
Legendary Perks - Fate Drum, Echoing Conch

6. Added "Ink Gem Replacement": Once every game, player may replace a equipped Ink Gem with another Ink Gem of the same rarity of their choice (out of two random options) using Grace's Refining Furnace (needs to be unlocked at the "Divine Decree of the Peach God")

1. Ink Pets and Aim Assist will no longer target invincible enemies

4. The indicators of magic circles will be increased accordingly when having increased magic circle range
5. Added Mouse Lock setting which confines the cursor within the game window when toggled on
6. Skills that only adds buffs such as Ink Skills of "Flash Ink", "Azure Ink" and "Abyss Ink" no longer has cast animations
7. Violetta Form's Ability "Protector Spin" no longer has cast animation. In addition, "Protector Spin" now summons 2 discs, and summons 4 discs when paired with "Tri-Spin"
8. Red Form's Ability "Endless Shockwave" will cast a weaker shockwave that deals 1/3 damage when using Powerful Swift Heavy Attack
9. Red Form's Ability "Twin Blades" has a larger attack range
10. Adjusted how Frost Points of General Gor Form's Ability "Frost Blast" is acquired. Now Frost Points can be acquired through Azure Ink's Azure Dragon Avatar
11. The attack windup of Miss Lee Form's "Enhanced Heavy Attack" can now be interrupted more conveniently
12. Shortened the windup animations of Monk Jin Form's Attacks
13. Adjusted the effect of Monk Jin From's Ability "Heavenly Flame" and the combined effect when having "Golden Wheel Strike: as well
14. The transparency of Player's Light Attack/Heavy Attack VFX as well as Ink Pets' attack VFX can now be adjusted in Settings
15. The portals between chapters are now fancier
16. Improved the visual effect of the scene of Keh 2nd phase Boss Fight
17. If you rolled "Ink Gem Duplicate" when gambling with Six, and you equip no Ink Gem or you equipped a Primordial Ink Gem, a random Legendary Ink Gem will drop as the reward
18. The % HP loss effect of Azure Wand will no longer take effect on the wood dummies in shops which would cause HUGE damage stats
19. Currency used to unlock talents is now called "Fox Blood" instead of "Blood Ink"
Experience Optimization

items.text: Hello, Awaken!

We're excited to bring you Patch 4! In this update, we've implemented bug fixes and improvements based on your valuable feedback, ensuring smoother gameplay and more refined mechanics. Thank you for your continued support as we work together to enhance your experience in Realm of Ink.

Added quick restart feature which allows player to give up and restart from first level.
Bug Fix

Happy gaming!

Hi Awakens,

We are thrilled to announce a major update for the Realm of Ink demo on Steam! Your journey through the mystical ink and wash world just got even more exciting with a plethora of new content and enhancements. Here’s what you can look forward to in this update:
Explore an uncharted and visually stunning new region within the Realm of Ink, filled with hidden secrets and breathtaking landscapes.
Prepare for battle against two formidable new bosses. Test your skills and strategies to overcome these epic challenges.
Unlock and master four new powerful Ink Gem Skills, each offering unique abilities to enhance your combat tactics and gameplay.
Discover and utilize 30 new Perks, allowing for deeper customization and more dynamic gameplay experiences.
Limited Meta Progression has now been upgraded to Full Meta Progression, providing a richer and more rewarding long-term gameplay experience.
Mid-tier Ink Pets and their skills have evolved into Top-tier Ink Pets and skills. Experience greater power and versatility with your companions.
Brand new design on the first floor of the Fox Inn with multiple interactive NPCs and features.
Uncover new systems and mechanics that add depth and variety to your adventures. These new features are waiting to be discovered and mastered.
Enjoy the immersive experience of English voice overs, bringing the characters and story to life like never before.

New difficulty level that allows you to challenge yourself.: We believe these updates will enhance your experience in the Realm of Ink and provide even more reasons to dive back into our ink-wash world. Your feedback has been invaluable in guiding these improvements, and we can't wait to hear what you think of the new content.: Thank you for your ongoing support and enthusiasm. Stay tuned for more updates and continue your journey in the Realm of Ink!
